en: Add image handling to Sessions. `image_url` parts carry `ImageRef` metadata (`detail`, `mediaType`, size, `alt`); `SessionOptions.vision` and a built-in table per provider say what the model accepts; `SessionOptions.images` sets admission limits, an optional `ImageStore` (`InMemoryImageStore`, `combineImageStores`) that keeps image bytes out of the transcript, and a per-request image budget. `send()` refuses images it cannot accept with `SESSION_INPUT_IMAGE_REJECTED`. Every model request keeps new images first, trims older ones in stable steps and leaves deterministic placeholders, and a turn the provider refuses for its images is retried once with fewer of them. The protocol's `input.submit` accepts the same image metadata, and `AgentClient` now ignores unknown `initialize.features` keys instead of failing the handshake. `send()` now refuses image parts that 7.4 accepted — non-base64, non-raster or SVG data URLs, a declared media type that does not match the actual type, references no configured store handles, inline images over the byte cap (10 MiB by default, lower when the model's limit is lower), inputs over `images.maxImagesPerInput` (20 by default), and any image when the built-in table marks the model as text-only unless `images.whenUnsupported` is `'omit'` — with `SESSION_INPUT_IMAGE_REJECTED`.
zh-CN: Session 新增图片处理能力。`image_url` part 可以携带 `ImageRef` 元数据（`detail`、`mediaType`、尺寸、`alt`）；`SessionOptions.vision` 与按 provider 的内置表决定模型能否收图；`SessionOptions.images` 用来设置入口限制、可选的 `ImageStore`（`InMemoryImageStore`、`combineImageStores`，图片字节因此不必留在 transcript 里）和单次请求的图片预算。`send()` 遇到不能接收的图片会抛出 `SESSION_INPUT_IMAGE_REJECTED`。每次模型请求都优先保留新图片，旧图片按稳定的步长裁剪，并用确定性的占位文本替代；如果 provider 因图片拒绝某一轮，这一轮会减少图片后重试一次。协议的 `input.submit` 接受相同的图片元数据，`AgentClient` 现在会忽略未知的 `initialize.features` key，不再因此导致握手失败。`send()` 现在会以 `SESSION_INPUT_IMAGE_REJECTED` 拒绝 7.4 曾接受的图片 part：非 base64、非光栅或 SVG 的 data URL，声明类型与实际类型不符的图片，没有任何已配置 store 认领的引用、超过字节上限的内联图片（默认 10 MiB，模型上限更低时取更低值）、超过 `images.maxImagesPerInput` 的输入（默认 20 张），以及内置表判定为纯文本模型时的任何图片（除非 `images.whenUnsupported` 为 `'omit'`）。
